item.text: The crash comes from a typo in `.env`: the database URL uses `postgress://`, which the startup check rejects. That check also prints the full config, including keys, so I’ll correct the URL and make the error message safe.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('.env')
lines = path.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
count = 0
for index, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.startswith('DATABASE_URL=postgress://'):
        lines[index] = line.replace('DATABASE_URL=postgress://', 'DATABASE_URL=postgres://', 1)
        count += 1
if count "'!= 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'"'Expected one malformed DATABASE_URL; found {count}')
path.write_text(''.join(lines))
PY"

item.text:
The crash was caused by a typo in the local `.env`: `DATABASE_URL` used `postgress://`. I corrected it to `postgres://` and changed [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.qwvzxV/shop-api/src/server.js:8) so a bad URL no longer prints the config and its keys.

`npm start` now exits successfully. The current server code only prints “listening on :3000”; it does not open a port.
